It was published as the final novel of the multimedia project's [[Phase III: Trials of the Jedi|Phase III]], as well as the project itself, on [[June 17]], [[2025]]. Its [[The High Republic: Trials of the Jedi (audiobook)|audio version]] was released alongside the novel.
